name: Genghis Khan Unifies the Mongols
summary: Temüjin is proclaimed Genghis Khan ("Universal Ruler") at a great quriltai on the Mongolian steppe, unifying all Mongol and Turkish tribes under a single authority for the first time. He issues the Yasa (code of laws), creates a new meritocratic military organization based on decimal units, and begins the conquests that will create history's largest contiguous land empire.

_quarry.structural_significance: Creates the Mongol Empire (1206–1368) which at its peak rules 24 million km²; the Pax Mongolica enables the first regular trade and communication across Eurasia; the Black Death travels the Mongol network to reach Europe.
